insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects the Shopify Storefront API and GraphQL Admin API. The recalculation occurs as of August 31, 2026.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should review their order update logic to ensure it accounts for the tax recalculation. This change may impact custom checkout implementations, particularly those using the Checkout UI extensions or Hydrogen. Developers should test their applications to ensure compatibility with the updated tax calculation. The orderUpdate mutation now returns the updated tax amounts, which should be reflected in the storefront.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations when updating shipping addresses on unfulfilled orders, ensuring compliance with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures merchants remain compliant with tax regulations. It also reflects Shopify's commitment to providing a seamless and accurate checkout experience.
